en.title: The Game Awards Nominees Revealed Ahead of GTA 6 Launch
en.summary: Get ready for the biggest night in gaming! The Game Awards is set to announce its 2026 nominees next week, just days before the highly anticipated launch of Grand Theft Auto 6.
en.body:
The annual celebration of all things gaming is gearing up for its 2026 iteration, and the first major milestone is fast approaching. **The Game Awards** will unveil its official nominees for the year during a special live broadcast next Tuesday, November 17. This reveal comes at a particularly exciting juncture, landing just two days before the monumental release of Rockstar Games' **Grand Theft Auto 6** on November 19.

The proximity of these two events is no accident. **Grand Theft Auto 6**, long considered a near-certain contender for Game of the Year, benefits immensely from this timing. Its eligibility for The Game Awards is secured by a razor-thin margin, with its release date falling just before the November 20 cutoff. This allows the game to be considered alongside its peers, despite the fact that many jurors may not have had the opportunity to play it extensively before casting their votes, as review codes are reportedly not being distributed by Rockstar.

## The Road to the Peacock Theater

The main event, **The Game Awards 2026**, is scheduled to take place on December 10 at the iconic Peacock Theater in Los Angeles. Hosted by the ever-enthusiastic **Geoff Keighley**, the show promises its signature blend of prestigious awards, groundbreaking world premiere announcements, and live musical performances. This year, the ceremony will also feature **PlayStation 5** joining the livestreaming efforts, potentially offering new ways for fans to engage with the broadcast and the winners as they are announced.

The eligibility window for games released in 2026 is notoriously tight, and **Grand Theft Auto 6**'s November 19 launch means it makes the cut by a single day. This has already ignited discussions within the gaming community, with many speculating on how a game that few have played extensively by the nomination deadline can be fairly judged. Jurors like **Alanah Pearce** have acknowledged the challenge, highlighting the complexities of evaluating a title under such circumstances. The anticipation for both the nominees reveal and the game's launch is palpable.

## What's Next for Gamers

Fans should mark their calendars for Tuesday, November 17, at 12 p.m. ET/9 a.m. PT for the nominee reveal special. Following that, all eyes will be on November 19 for the release of **Grand Theft Auto 6**. The main **The Game Awards 2026** ceremony will then crown the year's best on December 10.
